mentions.name: Inversion Works
mentions.description: An app-only lunch bowl restaurant chain built to execute very complex order customisation without breaking. It uses a "cook augmentation" system that takes over decision making and QA, plus app-only ordering accessible to AI agents, so customers can just tell their agent "I'm hungry" and receive a fresh, hot, healthy bowl. Currently at prototype stage and raising an angel round to run a live pop-up.
mentions.problem: Existing ordering systems break down when handling very complex customisation; the chain's cook augmentation handles that decision making and QA instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: An app-only lunch bowl chain that can execute very complex customisation without breaking. We've built "cook augmentation" that takes over decision making and QA, added an app-only ordering (accessible to the agents) and ended up with a frictionless experience where you just tell your agent "I'm hungry" and we cook a fresh, hot, delicious bowl that's good for you.
